text:
Sam: Quick sync  AtlasSI (systems integrator) + ChipCo (HW partner) want a joint channel for marketplace leads. We need a deterministic co-sell handoff policy before launch.
Ana: Agree. We should keep it simple: deterministic rules + human override for edge cases.
Devin: Suggestion: introduce a `lead_grant` token on lead creation. Token values: `atlas_primary`, `chipco_coop`, `redwood`. Token drives routing and reporting.
Peter: Love the token idea. How does token get assigned? auto from UTMs, partner portal, or manual set by partner ops?
Maria: Proposed assignment sources: (1) partner-portal referral => partner sets token, (2) marketplace utm (utm_source=chipco_market) => token=chipco_coop, (3) partner email intro creates `partner:atlas-intro` tag which maps to `lead_grant=atlas_primary` when validated.
Sam: We also need eligibility signals: account_tier (enterprise/mid/seed), recent_engagement (boolean), and current_stage. 
Ana: For co-sell economics, give AtlasSI priority on accounts where account_tier=enterprise OR partner did direct intro AND meeting scheduled. ChipCo priority only if lead originated from marketplace listing tied to ChipCo SKU.
Devin: Draft automation snippet for intake engine:
```
// evaluate in order
if has_tag('partner:atlas-intro') and meeting_scheduled_with_partner within 14d:
  lead_grant = 'atlas_primary'
else if utm_source == 'chipco_market' and partner_claimed == true:
  lead_grant = 'chipco_coop'
else if account_tier == 'enterprise' and not in_stage(['proposal','contract']):
  lead_grant = 'atlas_primary'
else:
  lead_grant = 'redwood'
```
Peter: Add a protection: if `named_account=true` then do NOT auto-grant without AE+SDR acknowledgement. Also, if Redwood already owns and stage >= Proposal, block reassignment.
Maria: We'll need SFDC fields: `lead_grant`, `partner_claimed_by`, `grant_reason`, `shadow_ops_owner`, `dispute_state`. Partnerships-bot should write these on changes.
Sam: Dispute flow idea: partner flags `claim:dispute` on lead -> partnerships-bot posts to #partnerships-disputes -> 12hr SLA to respond -> if unresolved, escalate to Partnerships Manager + Sales Leader with 48hr decision window.
partnerships-bot: automation note  will post claim disputes to #partnerships-disputes and set `dispute_state=open` on SFDC. :robot_face:
Ana: Add auditability: every auto-grant must write an `ownership_reason` string (rule id) and preserve previous owner in `ownership_history` field.
Devin: Engineering asks: intake API to accept `partner_intro_email` (string), `partner_portal_ref` (id), and `utm_payload` object. Also emit `lead_grant_changed` webhook events.
Peter: minor: we prefer `utm_payload` flattened into `utm_source` and `utm_campaign` fields for SFDC mapping.
Maria: Ops will create partner intro email templates that include a sentinel header `X-Partner-Intro: atlas` so parsing can be automated.
Sam: For joint announcements and marquee accounts, manual human review only. GTM + legal sign-off required before any partner gets grant.
Ana: During pilot, show a small banner in intake UI: "Grant: atlas_primary (rule: partner_intro_v1)" and a one-click appeal button that files `claim:dispute`.
Devin: I'll prototype the UI banner and webhook within the intake PR. Can we set timeline?
Peter: Timeline: intake API + SFDC fields by Tue next week, automation rules deployed to staging by Thu, UI banner by next Tue, pilot window 2 weeks after staging signoff.
Maria: I'll own the playbook and the partner-facing docs. Ops will run weekly review for disputes during pilot.
Sam: Any objections? If none, we'll lock and run pilot against the ChipCo marketplace launch.
Devin: No objections from eng.
Ana: All set from partnerships. I'll draft the playbook and circulate.
Peter: I'll coordinate with sales ops on SFDC field creation and permissioning.
partnerships-bot: noted  will attach a checklist comment once fields created.
